name: Agentic AI & GenAI Engineer
title: Agentic AI & GenAI Engineer
description: State-of-the-art engineering curriculum for autonomous AI agents and GenAI systems. Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangGraph cyclical state graphs, deterministic tool calling, multi-agent collaboration swarms, local LLM serving (Ollama/vLLM), structured outputs, semantic memory, and agent evaluation.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of LLMs & API integration

levels.title: Level 0 — LLM Foundations, Structured Outputs & Function Calling
levels.description: Transformer mechanics, tokenization, context windows, deterministic JSON outputs (Pydantic / Instructor), and function calling.

subjects.title: LLM Mechanics & Deterministic Outputs
subjects.description: Core subject domain covering LLM Mechanics & Deterministic Outputs.

topics.title: Structured Outputs, Tool Calling & Context Windows
topics.description: Master tool calling schemas, system prompt engineering, and deterministic structured extraction.
learningObjectives: Understand internal architecture and core mechanics of Structured Outputs, Tool Calling & Context Windows
Implement production-grade components using industry best practices for Structured Outputs, Tool Calling & Context Windows
Diagnose runtime errors, misconfigurations, and edge cases in Structured Outputs, Tool Calling & Context Windows
Explain design trade-offs and answer senior technical interview questions on Structured Outputs, Tool Calling & Context Windows

learningItems.title: Transformer Architecture Recap: Attention Mechanism, Token Limits & KV Cache
